newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan health workers start three-day strike.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan health workers start three-day strike.

text.p: Moroccan health workers on Tuesday started a three-day strike to press for pay increases and other benefits, a union spokesman said.
"The strike was observed on a large scale all over Morocco but we kept the emergency services," a spokesman affiliated to the Democratic Labour Confederation said.
Last month, the health workers held two 48-hour stoppages to push their demands which also include compensation for medical risks.

The spokesman said the authorities had rejected their request for permission to stage a peaceful march in Rabat on Wednesday but that a sit-in would go ahead at the health ministry on the last day of the strike.
There are 3,500 doctors and 40,000 paramedical staff in the public sector.
